ExR-2.5

Robotics built for real-world deployment

Designed for ATEX, IECEx Zone 1 and UL-listed hazardous environments, the ExR-2.5 delivers repeatable inspections while collecting high-quality visual, thermal, acoustic and environmental data.

Additional features

The ExR-2.5 can be configured with a range of additional modules and sensors to match your operational needs. Customers can select the capabilities required for their environment, from enhanced inspection and communication to advanced monitoring.

Available options include:

  • Enhanced inspection: PTZ cameras, acoustic cameras, thermal imaging, LED lighting, and inspection modules
  • Gas detection: Integrated sensors for monitoring gases such as methane (CH₄), hydrogen sulphide (H₂S), hydrogen (H₂), and VOCs
  • Communication: Optional microphone for remote interaction
  • Additional integration: Options such as remote pipe thickness monitoring and other expansion modules.

Our team can help configure the right ExR-2.5 setup based on your inspection requirements and operational environment.

let's talk

Ready to deploy

Whether you're deploying to a refinery, offshore platform or chemical plant, the ExR-2.5 is designed to move safely between sites.

  • Custom-engineered transport cases
  • Robust protection during shipping
  • Fast unloading and deployment
  • Compact system for straightforward site logistics
  • Ideal for permanent and temporary installations

Our software

Through our software partner Korial, operators can plan inspection missions, monitor robots remotely, review inspection results, and gain AI-powered insights from every mission.

  • Plan and manage autonomous inspection missions
  • Monitor robots remotely through a secure cloud connection
  • Review mission reports, including visual, thermal, audio, and gas inspection data
  • Integrate inspection data into existing systems via API

  • Audio analysis
  • Thermal annotations
  • Manometer detection and interpretation
  • Valve detection and analysis
  • Fire extinguisher detection
  • Person detection with face blurring
  • Fence anomaly detection
